oracle: Directed MPFR bounds; both endpoints round to the same binary64 (RNE).
abi: Every call verifies R4-R11, SP, bounded stack writes.
semantics: RNE return values; errno and floating exception flags are not implemented.
nan_result_policy: NaN results must be quiet; payload and sign are unspecified.
known_limitations: An undecided owned 1024-bit pow refinement still traps; all-input totality is unproved.
scope: Finite corpus, not an exhaustive proof over every binary64 input.
